title: Affect or Effect? Never Mix Them Up Again #shorts
description:
Affect or effect? Two confusing English words, one easy rule.
• Affect: usually the verb. Rain affects my mood.
• Effect: usually the noun. Rain has an effect on my mood.

Remember: affect is the action. Effect is the end result.

Which word pair confuses you? Write it in the comments.

Find another word for any word on anotherwordfor.net
